ActorTalk: I was just reading reviews of the films released recently.
Most of them don't seem to be doing very well...
Romance films are all the same bickering lovers with strict parents... Spy films are lone heroes and traitorous bosses...
They all feel like stories where you can guess the ending in five minutes.
Maybe that's because you started writing scripts yourself.
So you're more sensitive to story patterns now.
So your standards have gotten higher.
I wonder when we'll get to see Bianca's story on the big screen.
Then I should work even harder.
How about we go to a private cinema sometime? There are so many classics waiting for us.
Yes. To improve faster, I should start organizing my film study notes.
